questions.q: Which statement correctly describes the World Wide Web?
options: The global network of cables and routers
A collection of web pages accessed using the internet
A program used to view web pages
A system that converts domain names to IP addresses
questions.why: The web is the collection of pages; the internet is the network, a browser is the program and DNS does the conversion.

questions.q: What does a DNS server do?
options: Encrypts data sent to a website
Converts a domain name into an IP address
questions.why: DNS translates the domain name typed by the user into the IP address of the web server.

questions.q: A worm differs from a virus because a worm…
options: asks for a ransom to unlock files
records the keys a user presses
replicates itself across a network without needing a host file
questions.why: A worm is self-replicating and spreads on its own; a virus attaches to a file and needs it to be run.

questions.q: Explain how a firewall helps to protect a school network from hackers.
questions.model: A firewall monitors all incoming and outgoing network traffic and compares it with a set of rules. It blocks traffic that is not allowed, so unauthorised users cannot get into the network.
